text:
marta-g: Quick follow-up from last night's partial model loads — we need a concise postmortem follow-up thread and an action tracker that captures ownership, coverage windows, and recurrence expectations.
vikram: Agreed. PM reported auth vendor latency spikes ~48-72h. Treat as recurring until we have a durable fix + updated SLA.
joey: Current mitigations inventory: rollback script for bad manifests (joey), token cache with jittered TTL (sylvia), cross-region route (ops). Missing: circuit breaker on model loads and better alert classification.
sylvia: I'll own cache smoothing + health probe (/health/auth). Plan: TTL jitter + exponential backoff for token refresh. ETA: Fri EOD.
incident-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4539 — summary: "auth vendor latency caused partial model load failures".
ops-rotations: Request: tracker should include columns: primary, backup, backup_contact, coverage_window (UTC), rotation_cadence. That lets rotations swap ownership cleanly.
marta-g: Done — we'll add cadence defaults: infra owners weekly, oncall daily for the next 2 weeks. Also add a recurrence column (observed_interval_days).
vikram: Add a detection metric: p95_auth_latency over 30m moving window. If spike_count > 3 in 24h then page SRE and enable fallback routing.
joey: Draft runbook snippet for automation:
```yaml
trigger: auth_latency_spike
conditions:
  - window: 30m
    p95_ms: ">= 1200"
actions:
  - notify: #incidents
  - route: failover-region
  - enable: token_cache
```
sylvia: I'll wire the /health/auth probe and a webhook for the router. When healthcheck fails 3x in 5m router marks provider unhealthy and flips to fallback. ETA: Fri.
ops-rotations: Note: prefer degraded serving (smaller batches, read-cache) over full fail-open; prevents cascading retries.
marta-g: Action items (please ack):
- Sylvia: healthcheck + cache smoothing + PR link (ETA Fri)
- Joey: add circuit-breaker + playbook snippet + test plan (ETA Wed)
- Vikram: metric + alert rule + PagerDuty escalation mapping (ETA Mon EOD)
- Ops: add tracker coverage columns and start daily digest for 14 days (ops-bot)
sylvia: Ack. Will link PR when ready.
joey: Ack. Will include dry-run checklist.
vikram: Ack. Creating alert and PD mapping now.
incident-bot: Scheduled: ops-bot will post daily digest to #incidents @ 09:30 for 14 days.
marta-g: Also looping in legal/product for SLA review (roth@, legal@). If owners need extra help hitting ETAs ping me. :thumbsup:
